text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, Curren Chan's training was over,
but—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... Please wait up~!
Ayabe-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh. Why do I need to wait?
I'm in the middle of solo training."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yes♪ That's why Curren wants to run together with you too!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I wish to run alone.
...Excuse me."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Aaah, she left...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san is always like this.
Even though we share a dorm room together.
choice_data_list: Don't give up, let's attack one more time!
We could use a little break, don't you think?
Maybe we should take a little break, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san is always like this.
Even though we share a dorm room together.
choice_data_list: Don't give up, let's attack one more time!
We could use a little break, don't you think?
Maybe we should take a little break, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, totally! Let's go one more time! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...!
Ayabe-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Wha--!? You're still following me?
If you're just tailing me for fun, then--

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...I'm not doing this for fun.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
To Ayabe-san, Curren might just be an outsider...
...or maybe just a mere roommate, but still.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren wants to try running with you, Ayabe-san.
I feel like if I chase after your back,
I might be able to see a whole different world.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, I'm sorry to trouble you
by suddenly saying something like this.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Am I... being a bother after all?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...I never said that much.
Do whatever you want."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: —Yes! I'll do just as I please~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Curren Chan and Admire Vega kept running until the sun went down.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right!
Your mood changes from day to day, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hmm, taking a break, huh~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That night, in the dorm room—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Huh. The lights are still—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: *yaaawn*... Welcome baaack.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Curren tried waiting for Ayabe-san.
Before going to sleep, I thought...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for all your hard work today.
Make sure to talk to Curren again tomorrow, okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: *flops*

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Sigh. What's that supposed to mean?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Sleeping without even a blanket.
You'll catch a chill in your stomach, you know.
